mechanics.timing: A player city card. It is drawn and played with the other player cards.
rules: No effect text is printed on the card.
The city name and coordinates are printed again, rotated 180 degrees, along the bottom edge.
A compass rose in the top right shows N and an anchor.
The map has a crosshair over the city.
A small unlabelled schematic sits in the bottom-left corner. It is not a sticker slot.
A dashed improvement slot is printed across the center of the map.
